title: Six climate, critical-minerals and cybersecurity translations join the local edition
summary: Complete French-Canadian and Latin American Spanish readings bring the integrated inventory to sixteen of 34. The six texts retain their September 29 AI fidelity assessments and September 1 evidence cutoff. Eighteen translation contracts remain unfinished.
evidence_note: Integration occurred October 28. English authorship remains September 10; no source was freshly inspected for this integration. All ten previous translations and all 58 annual AI decisions are preserved. The annual accessibility appendix continues to bind the exact ten-translation inventory that it assessed, now exposed as a retained downloadable version.
publication_effect: Local content and provenance integration only. No independent human review, accessibility certification, operating observation, deployment or launch is claimed.
